title: Tech S And T Product Engineer-Ardoq-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
description:

**Job Title** 
 \- Product Engineer \- Ardoq
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 3 to 7 years
   

  

**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-time
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 We are looking for a Product Engineer – Ardoq to develop, configure, integrate, and enhance Ardoq\-based enterprise architecture solutions. The role combines Ardoq platform engineering, Python development, API integrations, data engineering, and AI\-enabled analysis.The candidate will work with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, Solution Architects, and technology teams to automate data ingestion, improve architecture data quality, and generate actionable insights from enterprise information.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, views, surveys, and permissions.
* Model applications, business capabilities, technologies, integrations, data flows, risks, and technical debt.
* Develop Python utilities and services for data ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and synchronization.
* Integrate Ardoq with systems such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, AWS, and other enterprise platforms.
* Build and maintain REST API integrations using JSON, HTTPS, authentication tokens, and service accounts.
* Apply AI and Large Language Models to analyze enterprise data, identify technical debt, classify findings, summarize issues, and generate recommendations.
* Develop and maintain AI prompts, response schemas, validation rules, and guardrails.
* Implement scheduled imports, data mappings, reconciliation, error handling, logging, and monitoring.
* Create Ardoq dashboards, visualizations, reports, and stakeholder\-specific architecture views.
* Support application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management, capability mapping, and application rationalization.
* Investigate and resolve integration, platform, access, AI\-output, and data\-quality issues.
* Prepare technical designs, integration specifications, operational runbooks, and user documentation.


**Must\-Have Skills:**
* 3 to 7 years of experience in product engineering, enterprise architecture tooling, integration development, or platform engineering.
* Hands\-on experience of Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, visualizations, surveys, and integrations.
* Strong Python programming skills, including API clients, data processing, automation, and error handling.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, HTTPS, OAuth 2\.0, API tokens, and integration troubleshooting.
* Experience with AI services such as Azure OpenAI or equivalent enterprise LLM platforms.
* Knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector search, AI agents, and prompt evaluation.
* Experience with Python frameworks and libraries such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Pandas, and Pytest.
* Experience with data transformation, validation, mapping, synchronization, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of business, application, data, integration, and technology architecture.
* Practical knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, grounding, and response validation.
* Experience using Git and standard software\-development practices such as code reviews, testing, and version control.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Experience integrating Ardoq with ServiceNow CMDB, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, or AWS.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and database integration.
* Experience with Application Portfolio Management and Technology Portfolio Management.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and cloud\-native application deployment.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with Postman, Swagger, OpenAPI, Power BI, and API\-management platforms.
* Exposure to technical debt assessment, technology risk, lifecycle tracking, and application rationalization.
* Familiarity with Ardoq ShiftX and business process modelling.


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
   

  

**Certifications(Added Advantage):**
* Ardoq Academy or Ardoq Partner certification
* Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate

title: Revenue Operations Reporting Specialist
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Reporting Specialist to own the build and ongoing maintenance of our GTM reporting. This is a focused, execution\-oriented role: the Specialist produces and maintains reports and dashboards in Salesforce (SFDC) and other sources to defined specifications, keeps the existing reporting library accurate and current, and works from a structured request queue.
   

  

 The role is designed to be delivered by an offshore resource working in close, documented coordination with our onshore Revenue Operations team. The Salesforce Reporting Specialist does the hands\-on building, refreshing, and quality\-checking of the reports.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role with overall accountability to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations \& Analytics.
   

  

***Preferred Location and Expected Work Hours***
 This role is based in Kochi, India. Given the need for real\-time collaboration with Dodge's US\-based GTM team, candidates should be comfortable working hours that overlap with US time zones, generally 12:00\-8:00 PM IST.
   

  

***Travel Requirements***
 Expected travel is less than 5% of the time but may occasionally be required for team meetings.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Build new Salesforce reports, custom report types, and dashboards to written specifications provided by the onshore Revenue Operations team
* Maintain, update, and troubleshoot the existing library of Salesforce reports and dashboards, keeping filters, groupings, and data sources accurate and current
* Build and refresh Business Intelligence dashboards and their underlying data extracts to defined specifications
* Perform routine quality assurance on reports and dashboards—verifying accuracy, checking for broken filters or stale data, and confirming figures reconcile to source
* Manage the report and dashboard catalog, including folder structure, naming conventions, and sharing and visibility settings
* Execute and monitor scheduled report refreshes and recurring distributions, confirming successful delivery
* Document report logic, field definitions, and change history so that reporting is transparent and reproducible
* Work a structured request/ticket queue, delivering standard reporting changes within agreed service\-level timeframes
* Log and escalate data discrepancies and suspected upstream data issues to the onshore team for root\-cause resolution
* Regression\-test reports and dashboards following Salesforce releases, additional Dodge hiring and role changes, or configuration changes, and flag anything that breaks


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field, and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 2\+ years building and maintaining reports and dashboards in Salesforce
* Proficiency with the Salesforce report builder, custom report types, and dashboards
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards in Tableau, QuickSight or other comparable Business Intelligence tool
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables
* Excellent written English and clear, asynchronous communication for documented coordination across time zones
* Highly detail\-oriented, with comfort working from specifications, queues, and service\-level expectations
* Reliable availability to overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM\-201\) or equivalent
* Exposure to Salesforce CPQ reporting
* Familiarity with SQL or other data\-preparation tools
* Prior experience working as part of a distributed or offshore delivery team


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

The company has strong expertise in sales outsourcing and in\-house lead generation, consistently aiming to improve results for every project undertaken.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Product Master Data Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kochi.
 **Dutco Tennant LLC** 
 is looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented
 **Product Master Data Specialist** 
 to join our team in Cochin. Dutco Tennant has over four decades of experience as a distribution partner for engineering and industrial solutions across construction, water, energy, infrastructure, and networking sectors in the Middle East and GCC.
 


 🔹 About the Role
 
 The Product Master Data Specialist will be responsible for
 **product master data governance, SKU/item creation, product classification, and Bill of Materials (BOM) management within Microsoft Dynamics 365** 
 .
 



 The role will ensure that quotations and sales orders use accurate and approved inventory SKUs while maintaining high standards of data quality and preventing duplicate or obsolete product records.
 


 🔹 Key Responsibilities
 * Own and manage the
 **Product Master Data Governance** 
 process.
* Create and maintain item masters, product attributes, categories, dimensions, and units of measure in
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365** 
 .
* Review and approve new SKU requests while preventing duplicate item creation.
* Create and maintain
 **Sales BOMs, Kit BOMs, and other BOM structures** 
 .
* Translate customer requirements into structured SKUs and BOMs.
* Establish and maintain product naming and classification standards.
* Maintain
 **HS/Customs codes, Country of Origin, manufacturer references, and technical attributes** 
 .
* Work closely with
 **Sales, Procurement, Warehouse, Engineering, Finance, and IT** 
 teams.
* Support SKU rationalization and archive obsolete items.
* Develop master data policies, workflows, and approval processes.
* Monitor data\-quality KPIs and prepare dashboards.
* Train internal users on product master data processes and ensure compliance.


 🔹 Requirements
 * Bachelor's degree in
 **Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Systems** 
 , or a related discipline.
* **5–8\+ years of experience** 
 in product master data, ERP, industrial distribution, manufacturing, or supply chain.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (D365 F\&O)** 
 is preferred.
* Strong understanding of
 **BOMs, inventory management, product structures, and ERP master data** 
 .
* Advanced
 **Microsoft Excel** 
 skills.
* **Power BI** 
 experience is desirable.
* Knowledge of industrial products such as
 **PVF, HVAC, MEP, Water Treatment** 
 , or similar products is preferred.
